'''Emotes''' ---- '''Emotes''' are used in-game to express yourself. The Roblox emote menu is disabled, but Roblox emotes can still be used with /e commands. The emote menu can be opened by pressing "G", tapping the emote button on a tablet/mobile or by pressing down on the d-pad on consoles.
